story.titleZh: 法拉利为何落后，以及接下来的计划
story.summaryZh: 法拉利在2026赛季开局良好，但下半赛季表现下滑，自7月斯帕站后未再登上领奖台。SF-26并非突然失去竞争力，而是对手尤其是迈凯伦的研发速度不断推高标杆，法拉利未能跟上，并推迟了自身升级计划的重要部分。
story.originalTitle: Why Ferrari has fallen back - and what it plans to do
story.summaryEn: Ferrari started the 2026 season well but has seen a negative trend in the second half, failing to reach the podium since Spa in July. The SF-26 has not suddenly become uncompetitive, but rivals' development rate, especially McLaren's, has progressively raised the benchmark and Ferrari has not kept up, having postponed a major part of its own upgrade plan.
detailZh: 在法拉利凭借巴塞罗那站的胜利迎来一个非常积极的夏季开局之后，其2026年F1赛季的下半程走势却要消极得多。
自7月斯帕站以来，它甚至都没能登上过领奖台。
有时它仍然展现出能够接近领先位置的实力，但随后却未能将这种潜力转化为实际的前三名完赛成绩。
SF-26并非突然变成了一辆缺乏竞争力的赛车，但对手——尤其是迈凯伦——的研发速度逐步推高了标杆，而法拉利近来未能跟上，实际上还推迟了自己升级计划中的很大一部分。
在匈牙利和荷兰之间，也就是夏休期前后，迈凯伦的MCL40获得了一系列空气动力学改进，尤其是底板区域，这让车队向前迈出了明显的一步。
除此之外，还有针对更快赛道的特定解决方案，比如特别的H翼，也就是迈凯伦自己版本的翻转翼——在匈牙利之后除马德里外的所有赛道都使用了——这在降低空气阻力成为优先事项时，拓宽了赛车的配置可能性。
但如果仅用空气动力学升级来解释迈凯伦的进步，那就过于简单化了。
据一些竞争对手称，沃金方面投入最重要工作的一个方面，涉及对轮胎的理解和激活。
这是一个特别重要的话题，因为早在2025年，将轮胎带入正确工作窗口的能力就已经对迈凯伦的表现至关重要，也是诺里斯尤其擅长利用的一个要素。
迈凯伦似乎正是在这一领域又向前迈进了一步。因此，这不仅仅是给MCL40增加了空气动力学负载的问题，而是在利用该负载并让轮胎处于正确窗口方面变得更加高效。
另一方面，在Maranello，早在Zandvoort之前就已经知道，在荷兰引入的升级不会带来特别大的性能提升。
事实上，底板的变化只是最初计划工作的一部分。
带到赞德沃特的这套升级方案，从概念上讲，大约相当于法拉利原本计划在该区域进行的升级的四分之三。一些更为重大的改动被推迟了——因为进展没有达到法拉利的预期。
由Loic Serra领导的技术团队，以及负责空气动力学部门的Diego Tondi，选择不为了赶上荷兰站的窗口而加速整个套件的生产。
法拉利更愿意给空气动力学专家更多时间在其他区域上工作，包括底板，并寻求更大的性能提升。
持续进行工作的区域之一涉及外缘，马拉内罗的技术部门给了空气动力学专家更多时间来开发，他们对当时已取得的收益并不满意，同时也考虑到了预算帽的限制。
预计在下个月晚些时候于美洲赛道，SF-26 上被推迟的改进将首次亮相。这些改进应包括对底板以及自六月巴塞罗那站之后空气动力学专家们持续研究的区域的更实质性升级。
法拉利已接受以一套不完整的方案度过本赛季当前阶段。据 The 比赛 了解，空气动力学部门在下半赛季围绕 SF-26 以非常动态的方式进行了大量工作，在风洞中在新旧部件之间更换不同组件。这是因为一些方案在风洞中并未产生很好的结果。
主要的新部件现在计划在奥斯汀推出，这既是出于后勤原因，也是因为这条赛道的布局非常适合评估所期望的进展。
法拉利的处罚计划正在最终确定
在动力单元方面，法拉利认为它已经通过ADUO 1和ADUO 2的研发达到了既定目标。一直以来都很清楚，ADUO允许的赛季内改动不会为引擎带来颠覆性变化，尽管如此，它仍然遵循了一条符合动力单元技术总监Enrico Gualtieri部门预期的研发曲线。
在蒙扎引入的ADUO 2规格，配备了第四台内燃机和第四台涡轮，据信已经达到了预期。
现在需要解决的问题涉及处罚：勒克莱尔的动力单元在意大利的事故后接受了大量检查，法拉利决定使用ADUO 1动力单元参加马德里站的比赛。
据信该动力单元得以幸存。然而，可以肯定的是，汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔都将在本赛季结束前安装新的动力单元。有传言称，车队可能会最早在下周末的巴库站解锁勒克莱尔的第五台动力单元，从而在那里接受罚退至队尾的处罚，而这条赛道的超车应该是可以实现的。
在车队的理想情况下，第五套动力单元肯定会是适用于勒克莱尔的ADUO 2规格，随后将在剩余的比赛中与在蒙扎引入的那套动力单元轮换使用。
是否在巴库接受罚退的决定，只会在阿塞拜疆大奖赛周末期间做出，届时勒克莱尔将在自由练习中使用蒙扎用过的那套动力单元。只有在此之后，并且还要取决于赛车所展现出的性能，法拉利才会决定是否安装新的动力单元并接受罚退。
牺牲在巴库的发车位并不是理想的选择，但这可能让勒克莱尔在接下来的比赛中使用更新的动力单元，同时还能保留在蒙扎引入的那套动力单元可供使用。
汉密尔顿的情况则不同，尽管在他的赛车上引入第五套动力单元的可能性依然存在。这一决定尚未最终敲定。但由于他目前似乎已经退出了车手总冠军的争夺，在剩余比赛中接受一次罚退、从而拥有两套ADUO 2动力单元可供轮换的可能性就变得更大了。
目前，被认为最合乎逻辑的两个地点是墨西哥城或英特拉格斯——或者如果法拉利希望提前进行更改，也可以选择在那三连赛开始时的奥斯汀。
这自然将在很大程度上取决于累积的里程数，以及未来几周内这位七届世界冠军动力单元池中现有动力单元的状况。
detailEn: After a very positive start to the summer for Ferrari with its Barcelona win, the second half of its 2026 Formula 1 season has had a much more negative trend.
It hasn’t even been on the podium since Spa in July.
At times it still shows it can be close to the leading positions, but then fails to turn that potential into an actual top-three finish.

The SF-26 has not suddenly become an uncompetitive car, but the development rate of its rivals – McLaren above all – has progressively moved the benchmark forward and Ferrari hasn't been able to keep up lately, having actually postponed a major part of its own upgrade plan.

Between Hungary and the Netherlands, either side of the summer break, McLaren’s MCL40 received a series of aerodynamic developments, especially around the floor, which allowed the team to make a clear step forward.

Added to these were specific solutions for the faster circuits, such as the particular H-wing, McLaren's own version of the flip-flop wing - used everywhere after Hungary except in Madrid - which broadens the car's configuration possibilities when reducing aerodynamic drag becomes a priority.
But it would be reductive to explain McLaren's progress exclusively through the aerodynamic updates.
According to some competitors, one of the aspects on which the most important work has been carried out at Woking concerns the understanding and activation of the tyres.

It is a particularly significant topic because already in 2025 the ability to bring the tyres into the correct operating window was very important in McLaren’s performance, and an element which Lando Norris in particular has managed to exploit.

McLaren seems to have made a further step forward precisely in this area. It is therefore not only a matter of having added aerodynamic load to the MCL40, but of having become more effective in exploiting that load and using the tyres in the correct window.
At Maranello, on the other hand, it was already known before Zandvoort that the update introduced in the Netherlands would not represent a particularly large performance step.
The changes to the floor were in fact only part of the work initially planned.

The package brought to Zandvoort can be considered, conceptually, around three quarters of the update Ferrari had planned in that area. Some of the more substantial interventions were postponed - because progress was not living up to what Ferrari had hoped.

The choice of the technical group led by Loic Serra, with Diego Tondi at the head of the aerodynamic department, was not to accelerate the production of the entire package simply to meet the Netherlands window.
Ferrari preferred to give the aerodynamicists more time to work on other areas, including the floor, and to look for a greater performance gain.

One of the areas on which work has continued concerns the outer edge, where Maranello's technical department gave the aerodynamicists more time to develop, dissatisfied with the gain that had been achieved up to that point and also taking the budget cap into account.

It is at the Circuit of the Americas late next month that the postponed interventions on the SF-26 are expected to make their debut. These should comprise a more substantial evolution of the floor and of the areas on which the aerodynamicists have continued to work since after Barcelona in June.

Ferrari has accepted going through the current part of the season with an incomplete solution. From what The Race has learned, the aerodynamic department has worked extensively around the SF-26 in a very dynamic way in the second part of the season, changing different components between new and old parts in the windtunnel. This is because some solutions had not produced great results in the windtunnel.
The main new parts are now scheduled for Austin, for both logistical reasons and because of the track layout, which is ideal for evaluating the hoped-for progress.
Ferrari's penalty plan is being finalised

On the power unit front, Ferrari believes it has reached the targets set with the ADUO 1 and ADUO 2 developments. It has always been clear that the in-season changes permitted under ADUO would not produce a game changer for the engine, which has nevertheless followed a development curve that has met the expectations of power unit technical director Enrico Gualtieri’s department.
The ADUO 2 spec introduced at Monza, with the fourth internal combustion engine and fourth turbo fitted, is understood to have lived up to expectations.
The issue to resolve now concerns penalties: Leclerc’s power unit underwent extensive checks following the accident in Italy, with Ferrari deciding to contest Madrid using the ADUO 1 power unit.

The unit is understood to have survived. However, it is certain that both Hamilton and Leclerc will fit a new power unit between now and the end of the season. Rumours suggest the team could choose to unlock Leclerc’s fifth unit as early as Baku next weekend, thereby serving the penalty that would send him to the back of the grid at a circuit where overtaking should be achievable.
The fifth unit will certainly be in ADUO 2 specification for Leclerc and would then be rotated with the unit introduced at Monza over the following remaining races, in the team’s ideal scenario.

The decision on whether to take the penalty in Baku will only be made during the Azerbaijan GP weekend, where Leclerc will run the unit used at Monza in free practice. Only afterwards, also depending on the performance shown by the car, will Ferrari decide whether to fit the new power unit and take the penalty.

Sacrificing the starting position in Baku is not the ideal option, but it could put Leclerc in a position to tackle the following races with a fresher power unit, while at the same time keeping the unit introduced at Monza available for use.

Hamilton's situation is different, although the possibility of introducing a fifth power unit on his car remains open. The decision has not yet been definitively made. But as he now appears to be out of the fight for the drivers' championship, the possibility of taking a penalty in one of the remaining races and having two ADUO 2 units to rotate becomes more likely.
At the moment, two places considered most logical would be Mexico City or Interlagos - or Austin at the start of that triple-header if Ferrari wants to bring the change forward.
Much will naturally depend on the mileage accumulated and on the condition of the power units present in the seven-time world champion's pool over the coming weeks.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
